case_title: SVETLANA BAYKALOVA VS. FOUNDER INSTITUTE INC.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,950.00 FILED BY BAYKALOVA, SVETLANA AS TO DEFENDANT FOUNDER INSTITUTE INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-23-2017 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF BAYKALOVA, SVETLANA ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF NO FEE FOR SERVICE SERVED FEB-01-2017, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT FOUNDER INSTITUTE INC.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT FOUNDER INSTITUTE INC.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-23-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-23-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF SVETLANA BAYKALOVA IS PRESENT. DEFENANT FOUNDER INSTITUTE INC. IS PRESENT. REPRESENTED BT ANDREW CRAWFORD, FIANCE MANAGER. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-23-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BAYKALOVA, SVETLANA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT FOUNDER INSTITUTE INC. PLAINTIFF MISSED A SPECIAL ASSIGNMENT AND WAS TERMINATED FROM DEFENDANT'S PROGRAM. THE CONTRACT STATES NO REFUNDS UPON ANY TERMINATION AFTER ONE WEEK. HOWEVER, A TERMINATED PARTICIPANT MAY ENROLL WITHOUT CHARGE IN A SUBSEQUENT PROGRAM TO WHICH PLAINTIFF REMAINS ENTITLED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
